logs: I was born a male in Minneapolis, United States. I was an accidental pregnancy.
My birthday is June 28. I am a Cancer.
My mother is Olivia Butkus, a marriage counselor (age 41).
My father is Gordon Butkus, a librarian (age 44).
I have an older brother named Peyton (age 1).
We have a family cat named Koko.
I drank a glass of milk after playing all morning.

scenarios.title: Favorite Drink
scenarios.body:
After playing all morning, your mother says you need to drink something and asks what sounds good.

What will you choose?

logs: I remained calm when my mother took me to the doctor's office to get vaccinated.
My big brother, Peyton, started elementary school.

scenarios.title: Vaccination
scenarios.body:
Your mother is taking you to the doctor's office to get vaccinated.

How will you behave?

logs: I admitted to my parents that I broke their mailbox.
I have been enrolled in elementary school at Little Bater Elementary School, a private school.

scenarios.title: Integrity
scenarios.body:
You broke your parents's mailbox while you were playing.

What will you do?

logs: I'm starting to think that there is nothing in this world better than building a fort.

scenarios.title: Canyon Neuron 5
scenarios.body:
Your parents have decided you're old enough to have a bicycle and want to buy you a brand new yellow Canyon Neuron 5.

How will you react?
